title: Pacers and crew rules — Hardrock 100
claims: In 2027 pacers are allowed from Grouse Gulch onward, and a runner may have only one pacer on course at a time.
Pacers may meet their runner and start only at crew-access aid stations; the KT station allows a pacer exchange only.

A pacer must run at least the whole leg to the next crew-access or specifically allowed aid station; there is generally no access for them in between, and they may not continue unless accompanying their runner.

All pacers must check in with aid-station personnel and sign a waiver to receive a wristband; crews are restricted to roughly a 400-yard radius of the aid station and may not meet runners outside crew stations.
